name: Hollow Choirling
lore: A small mouthless choir-husk that hums erased prayers until Deity battle line timing begins to slip.
visualDescription: Small bent humanoid with a smooth unfinished face, throat full of white fracture lines, ash ribbons floating from its shoulders.
mapBehavior: Stays behind Wretches and applies silence pressure to isolated lanes.

scaling.campaign: Fixed mission bands; old wins should become easier as Divine Level and gear rise.
scaling.eliteRemix: +12% hp, +10% damage, +1 mechanic layer, +1 tactical AI priority.
scaling.endgame: Dynamic scaling is capped at player effective level +8; adds mechanics before raw hp.
scaling.levelFormula: hp = baseHp * (1 + 0.045 * missionLevel); damage = baseDamage * (1 + 0.035 * missionLevel), capped by tier budget

aiProfile.counterplayWindow: Every major action has a telegraph or setup turn unless spawned as a minor swarmer.

balanceNotes: Harder solo tuning: Minor DISRUPTOR pressures one active deity through behavior first, stats second; threatWeight 1.0 controls encounter budgets.
